assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. TWO original medieval care-village interior vignettes, review pixel art. Reference supplies cold reed-basin materials, muted brown grey olive and worn blue timber, not its village plan. Coarse hard pixel clusters, top-down oblique orthographic square-axis rooms, horizontal back walls vertical posts, no diamond isometric. LEFT small ordinary-care consultation hall on DRY land: care-needs tray with cup and folded cloth near open doorway, and SEPARATE optional observation invitation hanging BLANK on distant wall, not over entry. Plain wood observation desk partitioned by linen curtain from a single simple examination couch; curtain does not block public route. RIGHT quiet personal resting hut, different from multi-bed camp: one modest low bed, patient's reachable small OLD HOUSE KEY on bedside tray next to a closed personal bag easy to lift, folded blanket and BLANK limited proxy token separate. Broad civilian OPEN door directly to DRY village street; no laboratory or signed research desk between bed and exit. All huts ground-level, no stairs over wet reeds, visible dry path continues beyond frame. Empty scene never implies departed/dead patient or consent. No locked restraints, new medical machines, glowing medicines, luxury, labels, readable text, names, modern red-cross symbols or watermark. This adds consultation/privacy and retained house-key space, does not redraw whole care camp.
assets.qa: Consultation hall care tray/invitation separated, curtain shields single couch while leaving doorway clear; quiet hut gives bedside key, liftable bag and independent dry exit. Door thresholds have shallow steps despite requested ground level, accessible widths/slope need production checking. All empty furniture is review staging, not capacity or patient departure.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval cold-reed village TWO small paired pixel-art review spaces. DO NOT redraw main three-pipe hospital room. Reference only worn blue timber, thatch, grey stone and muted olive reeds. Coarse square pixel clusters, top-down oblique orthographic view, axis-aligned square ground, horizontal walls vertical posts; no diamond isometric. LEFT tiny dry EMBANKMENT inspection pavilion: on workbench TWO detached pipe-joining rings visibly of different age, one newer copper-brown and one heavily weathered dark iron; separate closed small fixed water-sample bottle with wax seal, short timing-tally board with simple notches, no writing. Behind pavilion a SHORT raised capped new pipe section is physically separate from a low OLD stone domestic water channel, no connection between them and no water mixing. Wet dangerous side fenced off, broad continuous DRY ground path across foreground passes around safely. RIGHT modest shift-operated water shelter faces this dry path: a FEW lidded usable water buckets on low rack, blue plain bucket tags, family completed-shift WOODEN tally tray distinct from a currently EMPTY replacement-shift slot, empty stool for waiting replacement. No drinking tests, patients, laborers already arrived, miracle recovery, magical purifier or automatic endless water. Doors/open fronts do not route through wet channel. Materials ordinary medieval, no modern valves/gauges, no text, letters, numbers, red-cross emblem or watermark. Distinguish pipe-age inspection from finite water and caregiver shifts, not a complete hydraulic plan.
assets.qa: Distinct age rings and sealed sample, raised capped section separate from old open channel; dry foreground route stays outside wet fence. Lidded tagged buckets, completed-shift tally and empty replacement tray/stool visible. Perspective drifted into diagonal/isometric huts unlike requested square axes; keep as materials/prop review, not tile-layout template. No new treatment outcome.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Review-only pixel-art board of TWO original medieval cold basin small work spaces. Critical camera: facade walls run HORIZONTALLY across image, posts VERTICAL; all floor grid lines horizontal/vertical, no diagonal isometric hut or diamond island. Coarse low-detail hard pixel clusters, muted grey brown faded blue olive. LEFT tiny GROUND-LEVEL well-measurement alcove on stable DRY embankment, NOT the underground drainage station: protected low stone sample port with CLOSED iron cap and narrow fixed mechanical measuring rod beside it, sealed small well-pressure reference bottle and old notched timing token on simple bench, capped unused pipe stub. Keep main deep-well entry entirely OUT OF FRAME; no second shaft, descent or glowing crystal. RIGHT independent ladder-crew waiting room: short stored ordinary maintenance LADDER lies secured against side wall, not descending anywhere; table has two SEPARATE small wage-token trays for nursing shift and maintenance shift, spare caregiver stool EMPTY in front of unused replacement-shift peg, simple bench and cup. Two open room exits both lead directly to same visibly DRY high embankment path, no watery steps, cellar, lab or required checkpoint. Caregiver rest is legitimate and empty stool means replacement not arrived, no implied abandoned patient. No actual workers, signatures, payment conclusion, magical machinery, modern dial gauge, text, labels, numbers or watermark. Complement existing underground well scene with surface waiting/finite labor, do not redraw full well.
assets.qa: Ground capped port and fixed rod with separate sample/time props; finite two-tray wage distinction, empty replacement stool and stored ladder visible. Ladder drawn vertical rather than lying down, secured to wall with rope; no descent. Waiting room is open-front with lateral edge access, exact two-door topology not achieved and must be redrafted for collision.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Two original medieval cold-basin care-village spaces shown side by side, connected only by clean DRY public yard. REVIEW pixel art. Reference for faded blue timber, brown thatch, grey stones and muted olive reeds only. COARSE crisp hard pixel clusters; horizontal facade walls vertical posts, axis-aligned square floor grid, top-down oblique orthographic, no diamond isometric. LEFT finite-care allocation hall: short shelf holds just a few plain cloth bundles and jugs with clear EMPTY inventory bay; on table exactly TWO unequal-size plain earthenware ration bowls, an EMPTY wooden shortage tally frame next to them. Separate closed ordinary-care cupboard, NO enormous medicine reserve, no beds. RIGHT unconditional waiting room for people declining observation: plain unlabeled bench, ordinary cup of water within reach, closed unsigned observation booklet stored on SIDE shelf away from exit, one blank personal stay/leave token on low table, separate small closed cupboard. OPEN front exit leads straight outside to broad public dry yard; nobody must pass signature desk or research gate to leave or receive ordinary water. No characters, signatures or presumed relocation, no glowing drugs, modern medical symbols, barred windows, labels, names, numbers, text or watermark. Clear sparse reusable props and full visible room floor; empty seat is not proof of refusal or arrival.
assets.qa: Exactly two unequal bowls, visible empty shelf and independent waiting room with water, closed unsigned booklet and personal token. Exit bypasses observation materials. Shortage frame rendered with rods rather than completely empty frame; empty shelf carries shortage meaning, no numeric stock claim. Background dry paths visible; generation does not establish occupancy, consent or receiving capacity.
